03/10.12.2024 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Lalmatia P.S. Case No. 72 of 2023, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)
(n), 307 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Sri Satish Kumar Munda, learned Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, Godda.
On 22.08.2023 at about 8:30 A.M., the informant had gone to graze his cattle.
When he returned home, he found his wife in unconscious state and semi nude condition.

Attention of this Court has been drawn towards the statement of the victim recorded at paragraph 77 of the case diary in which she has stated that the petitioner had assaulted her due to which she sustained injury.
She has specifically stated that she was not subjected to rape.
From perusal of injury report, it appears that the victim has sustained grievous injury on her head.
It was submitted that petitioner is in custody for more than five months.
It was further submitted that the victim has not supported the factum of rape.

sentences.text: 1 In view of the aforesaid fact, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Satish Kumar Munda, learned Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, Godda or his successor, in connection with Lalmatia P.S. Case No. 72 of 2023.
(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
